integrity: The group Fourier decomposition, Chebotarev prime-minor theorem, cosine determinant analysis and coefficient constructions are included in full. No third-party paper is reproduced. The source date denotes the first public version of the motivating prime-minor literature, not a date of this finding.
scientific_limitations: The exact four-level classification is confined to three distinct nonzero complex taps and dihedral groups of twice an odd prime order. Finite numerical rank checks corroborate but do not prove the theorem. Historical priority may be affected by an equivalent result in weighted Cayley or group-algebra terminology; no independent audit is claimed.
title: Complete three-tap Fourier-rank spectrum on odd-prime dihedral groups
